spans.s:
मैथिलः [मिथिलायां भवः अण्] A
king of Mithilā;

.
--लाः (pl.) The people of
Mithilā q. v.
--ली N. of Sītā;

मैथुन a. (नी f.) [मिथुपेन निर्वृत्तं
अण्]
1 Paired, coupled.
--2 United by
marriage.
--3 Relating to copula
tion.
--नं
1 Copulation, sexual
union; मृतं मैथुनमप्रजं

.
--2
Marriage.
--3 Union, connection.
--4
Consecrating the fire (अग्न्याधान).
--Comp.
--ज्वरः the excitement of sexual
passion.
--धर्मिन् a. copulating.
--वैराग्यं abstinence from sexual
intercourse.

मैथुनिका Union by marriage,
matrimonial alliance^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210122. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48.

मैथुनिन् a. Copulating, sexually
united. --m. One who has had
sexual union with a woman.
